entities.name: Protocol configuration options
entities.description: Information element used by the UE to transmit protocol data such as configuration parameters, error codes, or messages/events to the network.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that initiates transmission of protocol data to the network using the PCO IE.

entities.name: PCO inclusion condition
entities.description: Condition for including the PCO IE: when UE wishes to transmit protocol data and extended protocol configuration options is not supported by UE or network end-to-end for the PDN connection.

entities.name: Extended PCO not supported
entities.description: Property indicating that extended protocol configuration options are not supported by UE or network end-to-end for the PDN connection.

relations.description: UE triggers transmission of PCO IE when it wishes to send protocol data to network.
PCO IE inclusion is guarded by the condition that UE wishes to transmit protocol data and extended PCO is not supported.
The inclusion condition establishes that extended PCO must not be supported by UE or network end-to-end for PDN connection.
